question: Why cannot the great Lord's consciousness-form be said?
premises: such was clearly said by me in fifteen verses
inference: Because of immeasurability of the consciousness-form of the great Lord, it is not possible to say; such was clearly said by me in the middle of the fifteen verses on awakening.
plain_english: Because of the immeasurability of the consciousness-form of the great Lord, it cannot be said; such was clearly said by me in the middle of the fifteen verses on awakening.
